findings.title: Renamed function breaks callers
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but `src/alerts.ts` still imports and calls `readSensor` on line 2. This will cause a runtime `ReferenceError` unless the import in `alerts.ts` is also updated.

findings.title: Naming does not match local convention
findings.body: The new function name `sampleSensor` deviates from the existing local convention of using `read` for sensor access functions (e.g., `readSensor` in the old version). Renaming it to `readSensor` would align with the local pattern.

summary.problem: The renamed function breaks existing callers and deviates from local naming conventions.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and unchanged.
